'''March 2000 Phoenix tournament (Friday)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 10 March 2000. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d346">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-13-tempe-az-3-13-00d346/ tempe-az-3-13-00], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 13 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-13-tempe-az-3-13-00d346/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2000
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
